children.innerHTML: Write two paragraphs: what happened, and what you'd like to be true in a year. That's all a first meeting needs.
Read by a partner the same working day. Attachments welcome, panic optional.
The clerks' desk, weekdays 8:30–18:00. After hours, leave the number a partner should call.
Twenty minutes by appointment. The good coffee is for visitors.
Before we read a word of substance, we check we're free to act. Usually same day.
An hour with the right partner. You talk, we ask, nobody performs. Free, and privileged either way.
Scope, strategy and a fee arrangement in plain language. Signed only when you're comfortable.
You get one partner's mobile number and a promise: no invoice will ever be the first you've heard of the work.
For advisory work billed by time, in six-minute units we round in your favour
Formations, financings, estate plans and most documents: one number, quoted first
Budgeted in phases with a decision point at each gate. No meter left running
Every new matter starts with a conversation that costs precisely nothing
Everything you tell us, from the first email onward, is privileged. We have kept secrets for thirty-nine years; yours will not be the exception.

meta_description: How to begin, what happens next, and fees discussed like adults, including the free first hour.
